'''''Audacious''''' was a [[Lianna-class corvette|''Lianna''-class corvette]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
After the [[NOVA]] project was disabled by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] infiltrators on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], the ''Audacious''&mdash;along with the [[Reliant (Lianna-class)|''Reliant'']]&mdash;pursued the modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Star of the Tion]]'' in an attempt to cut off the Rebel's escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

Hindered by the congestion of space traffic around the planet Lianna, the ''Audacious'' tried to herd the Rebels toward the waiting ''Reliant'', nearly ensnaring the freighter between them. However, the ''Audacious'' was unsuccessful in driving the ''Star of the Tion'' toward the ''Reliant'' and both [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] pulled back to let a waiting [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] on sector patrol&mdash;the [[Warlord/Legends|''Warlord'']]&mdash;make an attempt to stop the Rebels.
